description: Source code for an IPSO Temperature Sensor object implementation in Zephyr RTOS, including resource definitions, instance management, and initialization functions.

methods.name: update_min_measured
methods.description: Updates the minimum measured temperature value for a sensor instance and notifies observers.

methods.name: update_max_measured
methods.description: Updates the maximum measured temperature value for a sensor instance and notifies observers.

methods.name: reset_min_max_measured_values_cb
methods.description: Callback to reset min/max measured values for a sensor instance.

methods.name: sensor_value_write_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when sensor value resource is written to, updates min/max values accordingly.

methods.name: temp_sensor_create
methods.description: Creates a new IPSO temperature sensor instance with default resource values.

methods.name: ipso_temp_sensor_init
methods.description: Initializes the IPSO temperature sensor object and registers it.
